top: And I sought for a man among them,
bottom: that should make up the hedge, and stand in the gap...

top: ...and shall build houses, and plant vineyards;
bottom: yea, they shall dwell with confidence...

top: None of his sins that he hath committed
bottom: shall be mentioned unto him...he shall surely live.

top: Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep,
And shall put my spirit in you, and ye shall live,
bottom: and I shall place you in your own land...

top: ...and his voice was like a noise of many waters:
bottom: and the earth shined with his glory.

top: And they shall teach my people
bottom: the difference between the holy and profane...
